# Repository Instructions

## Existing Rules

- Keep changes small and reviewable.
- Update docs when behavior changes.

## Meta Harness: code-review-harness

Goal: Use the generated code review harness for structured multi-role review work.

When to use:
- Comprehensive code review requests
- Review harness generation or refresh requests

Primary generated assets:
- `generated/code-review-harness/harness.yaml`
- `generated/code-review-harness/roles/`
- `generated/code-review-harness/skills/`
- `generated/code-review-harness/evals/`
